verdict.rationale: USPTO's own Patent Center page acknowledges direct API calls against versioned Workbench/view-application APIs. Probes confirm a real api.uspto.gov endpoint that answers unauthenticated requests with an auth challenge, and a developer portal at developer.uspto.gov, but the portal's documentation could not be read by a plain fetch. That makes the API real, but its documentation is largely unevidenced. Missing for 10: readable published endpoint documentation, a documented key-issuance path, stated rate limits, and any OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404).

support.subject: As a developer, the service documents a public API for its data — published endpoints, a key-issuance path, and stated rate limits on its own pages

citations.quote: For users making direct API calls to Workbench/view applications, this update required a change to the version level of the APIs within Workbench/view applications.
a real machine endpoint that answers unauthenticated requests with a structured auth challenge
